title: [Đề 01] Đề Minh Họa Chính Thức VNU Test Bậc 3 — ULIS ĐHQGHN
description: Đề thi minh họa công bố chính thức từ Trường Đại học Ngoại ngữ – ĐHQGHN (ULIS). Dùng làm bài kiểm tra chẩn đoán đầu vào (Diagnostic Test): Temperature and Thermometers (Part 2), Five Star Fitness Center (Part 3), Staying Active in Retirement (Part 4), Employee of the Year (Writing).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) that matches the meaning of each sign or notice.

questions.prompt:
CHILDREN’S PLAY AREA
NO PETS HERE!

options.text: Pets are expected to stay out of this area.
Pets are required to play in this area only.
Kids should be kept away from pets here.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo ghi rõ: 'CHILDREN’S PLAY AREA - NO PETS HERE!' (Khu vực vui chơi của trẻ em - Cấm thú cưng ở đây). Do đó, thú cưng được yêu cầu phải ở ngoài khu vực này ('stay out of this area'). Phương án A là đáp án chính xác.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ở bên ngoài, không đi vào

questions.prompt:
NO ENTRY
WITHOUT PERMISSION

options.text: People can come in here if they are allowed.
No one should go in without being requested.
Entrance to this area is prohibited for everyone.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo: 'NO ENTRY WITHOUT PERMISSION' (Không vào nếu không có sự cho phép). Điều này có nghĩa là mọi người có thể vào nếu họ được phép ('if they are allowed'). Phương án A diễn đạt tương đương chính xác.

questions.prompt:
First Monday every month
FREE 2nd pizza of any size

options.text: You are offered a free pizza on Mondays.
You can get an extra pizza at no cost monthly.
You should buy two pizzas every first Monday.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo: 'First Monday every month - FREE 2nd pizza of any size' (Thứ Hai đầu tiên mỗi tháng - Miễn phí bánh pizza thứ 2 bất kỳ cỡ nào). 'First Monday every month' tương đương 'monthly', 'FREE 2nd pizza' tương đương 'an extra pizza at no cost'. Phương án B chính xác.

questions.prompt:
DISCOUNT AVAILABLE
For online shopping only

options.text: Online shoppers can register for a discount.
The usable discount can only be found online.
Customers can buy online at discounted prices.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo: 'DISCOUNT AVAILABLE - For online shopping only' (Có giảm giá - Chỉ dành cho mua sắm trực tuyến). Điều này có nghĩa khách hàng có thể mua hàng trực tuyến với giá giảm ('buy online at discounted prices'). Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: giá đã chiết khấu, giá giảm

questions.prompt:
* NATIONAL CINEMA DAY *
FREE WATCHING
- One kid per paying adult
- To be qualified: 3 years or below

options.text: Any 3-year-old kid can watch free movies at this place.
Tickets for kids are free on national cinema day.
One paying adult can bring a 2-year-old kid here for free.

questions.explanationVi: Điều kiện xem phim miễn phí: 1 trẻ em đi kèm 1 người lớn trả tiền và trẻ em từ 3 tuổi trở xuống. Trẻ 2 tuổi thỏa mãn điều kiện '3 years or below', và đi kèm 1 người lớn trả tiền thì được miễn phí. Phương án C hoàn toàn chính xác.

questions.prompt:
VNU Campus
JOB FAIR 2024
For more information
Call 024 367 5588, or
Email at jobfair.vnu@gmail.com

options.text: The event may provide you a job opportunity.
Email us if you want to book a spot at the event.
You should make a call to the event holder.

questions.explanationVi: 'JOB FAIR 2024' (Ngày hội việc làm) là sự kiện cung cấp cơ hội việc làm ('job opportunity'). Thông tin liên hệ ghi 'Call... or Email...' là lựa chọn, không bắt buộc gọi điện. Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
PERMIT PARKING for RESIDENTS ONLY
Vehicles without valid parking permits will be towed at vehicle owner’s expense

options.text: This parking space is limited to those living here.
Visitors can park here if residents agree.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo ghi rõ: 'PERMIT PARKING for RESIDENTS ONLY' (Đỗ xe có giấy phép - Chỉ dành cho cư dân). 'Residents only' tương đương với 'limited to those living here' (chỉ giới hạn cho những người sống ở đây). Phương án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: chủ xe tự chịu chi phí

tasks.title: Part 2: Cloze Test
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each blank from 8 to 15.

passage.title: Temperature and Thermometers
passage.text: Temperature measures how hot or cold something is. We usually use a thermometer to measure it. A basic thermometer is a long thin tube (8) ________ with liquid mercury or alcohol. When it gets hotter, the liquid expands and rises. It has a (9) ________ which shows how hot or cold things are. Most of the world uses Celsius degrees but, in the USA and some (10) ________ places, they use Fahrenheit degrees. Scientists like to use Kelvin degrees (11) ________ it starts from absolute zero, the coldest possible temperature. In physics, temperature is about how fast molecules move in (12) ________ material. The faster they move, the hotter it gets. Understanding temperature is important in science, where temperature, pressure, and volume are connected (13) ________ the laws of physics. It helps us study and (14) ________ weather patterns. For students, (15) ________ thermometers is a useful skill that helps them learn about science in their everyday lives.

questions.prompt: A basic thermometer is a long thin tube (8) ________ with liquid mercury or alcohol.
questions.explanationVi: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ dạng bị động: 'a tube which is filled with...' rút gọn thành 'a tube filled with...' (ống được đổ đầy chất lỏng thủy ngân hoặc cồn). Phương án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: được làm đầy với, chứa đầy

questions.prompt: It has a (9) ________ which shows how hot or cold things are.
questions.explanationVi: 'scale' là thang đo nhiệt độ trên nhiệt kế (vạch chia độ). 'ruler' là thước kẻ đo chiều dài, 'measurement' là phép đo. Phương án B là từ chính xác.

questions.prompt: Most of the world uses Celsius degrees but, in the USA and some (10) ________ places, they use Fahrenheit degrees.
questions.explanationVi: 'some other + danh từ số nhiều' (places). 'another' chỉ đi với danh từ số ít, 'extra' mang nghĩa phụ/bổ sung. Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: Scientists like to use Kelvin degrees (11) ________ it starts from absolute zero...
questions.explanationVi: 'since' mang nghĩa 'bởi vì' (chỉ lý do các nhà khoa học thích dùng độ Kelvin). 'although' (mặc dù), 'whether' (liệu rằng). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: In physics, temperature is about how fast molecules move in (12) ________ material.
questions.explanationVi: 'material' ở đây là danh từ đếm được số ít mang nghĩa 'một chất liệu / vật chất bất kỳ' chưa xác định trước đó, do đó dùng mạo từ bất định 'a'. Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: ...where temperature, pressure, and volume are connected (13) ________ the laws of physics.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc bị động chỉ tác nhân: 'be connected by the laws of physics' (được liên kết bởi các định luật vật lý). Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: It helps us study and (14) ________ weather patterns.
questions.explanationVi: Kết hợp từ chuẩn xác: 'predict weather patterns' (dự báo các kiểu hình thời tiết). Con người không thể 'control' (kiểm soát) thời tiết. Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: For students, (15) ________ thermometers is a useful skill...
questions.explanationVi: Cụm danh động từ cố định trong tiếng Anh: 'reading thermometers' (đọc chỉ số nhiệt kế / xem nhiệt độ). 'operating' là vận hành máy móc phức tạp. Phương án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: đọc chỉ số trên đồng hồ/dụng cụ đo

tasks.title: Part 3: True / False
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and decide whether the statements from 16 to 20 are True or False. Choose A for True and B for False.

passage.title: Five Star Fitness Center
passage.text:
The Five Star Fitness Centre is dedicated to fostering a holistic approach to health, with a special emphasis on the ancient practice of Yoga guided by Indian Yoga Masters. Our diverse classes, including Hatha, Vinyasa, and Ashtanga, cater to all levels, from beginners seeking stress relief to advanced practitioners aiming to deepen their practice.

In addition to Yoga, we offer tailored wellness programs, including nutritional guidance and mindfulness meditation, to support overall vitality. Joining our community provides access to personal training and exclusive workshops, fostering growth and balance.

Flexible membership plans with attractive rates:
- 1-day pass: VND 50,000
- 2-week plan: VND 400,000
- 1-month plan: VND 500,000
Experience tranquility and empowerment at Five Star Fitness Centre today!

questions.prompt: The center employs an age-old method to promote wellness.
questions.explanationVi: Trong bài: '...with a special emphasis on the ancient practice of Yoga...'. Từ 'ancient practice' (bộ môn cổ xưa) đồng nghĩa với 'age-old method' (phương pháp lâu đời). Do đó câu nhận định là ĐÚNG (True).

questions.prompt: Classes are organized separately according to the members’ levels.
questions.explanationVi: Bài đọc viết: 'Our diverse classes... cater to all levels, from beginners... to advanced practitioners' (các lớp học đa dạng phục vụ mọi trình độ). Bài không nói các lớp được phân chia tổ chức riêng biệt theo cấp độ. Do đó nhận định là SAI (False).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: phục vụ, đáp ứng nhu cầu

questions.prompt: Practice sessions can change to meet the members’ specific goals.
questions.explanationVi: Bài đọc viết: 'we offer tailored wellness programs... to support overall vitality' và 'personal training' (chương trình may đo theo mục tiêu riêng). 'Tailored' đồng nghĩa với có thể thay đổi để đáp ứng mục tiêu cụ thể. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: được may đo, thiết kế riêng

questions.prompt: The center is particularly for persons who need nutritional guidance.
questions.explanationVi: Trung tâm tập trung chính vào Yoga ('special emphasis on... Yoga'), hướng dẫn dinh dưỡng chỉ là một phần bổ trợ thêm ('In addition to Yoga, we offer... nutritional guidance'). Từ 'particularly' (đặc biệt chuyên biệt) biến câu thành SAI (False).

questions.prompt: The one-month membership offers cost savings compared to the others.
questions.explanationVi: So sánh biểu phí: Gói 1 ngày = 50.000đ (30 ngày = 1.500.000đ); gói 2 tuần = 400.000đ (4 tuần = 800.000đ); gói 1 tháng = 500.000đ. Rõ ràng gói 1 tháng mang lại lợi ích tiết kiệm chi phí lớn nhất. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True).

tasks.title: Part 4: Reading Comprehension
tasks.instructions: Read the following passage and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question from 21 to 25.

passage.title: Staying Active in Retirement
passage.text:
We all know we should exercise often, but as the years go by, it is easy to let activity levels slide. Busy lives get in the way and retirement can become a sedentary experience. But it is never too late to begin a new fitness routine.

Health problems can happen in mid-life, and as we grow older, these conditions are harder to solve. A 2011 report in the British Medical Journal revealed that older people who regularly did moderate exercise lived over six years longer than those who did no exercise. Personal trainer Health Columnist, 58, says it is never too late to improve fitness. 'It is extremely important for people in their fifties and beyond to take an interest in fitness,' he says. Chris had health problems in his forties and was warned that his life was in danger if he did not lose weight. He changed his lifestyle and became a fitness champion at 55. He now runs a fitness website for the over-fifties.

Swimming is one of the best exercises for strength and flexibility. A daily or even weekly swim puts no pain on muscles, while helping people become flexible. Other options include walking and cycling.

questions.prompt: What is the word 'slide' in paragraph 1 closest in meaning to?
questions.explanationVi: Trong câu 'it is easy to let activity levels slide' (rất dễ để mức độ vận động bị trượt dốc / giảm sút), từ 'slide' đồng nghĩa với 'decline easily' (giảm sút dễ dàng). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt: What is mentioned in paragraph 2?

options.text: It takes an old person over six years to improve their fitness.
There was a decrease in death rates according to 2011’s report.
Health problems in older age are far from easy to address.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ: 'Health problems can happen in mid-life, and as we grow older, these conditions are harder to solve' (các vấn đề sức khỏe khó giải quyết hơn khi già đi). Cụm 'harder to solve' đồng nghĩa với 'far from easy to address' (không hề dễ xử lý). Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: What does Health Columnist say about the elderly?

options.text: They are encouraged to get involved in fitness.
They possibly face a lot of fitness challenges.
They should visit his website for fitness advice.

questions.explanationVi: Health Columnist khẳng định: 'It is extremely important for people in their fifties and beyond to take an interest in fitness' (vô cùng quan trọng để người trên 50 tuổi quan tâm đến thể lực). Điều này tương đương việc họ được khuyến khích tham gia tập luyện thể chất ('encouraged to get involved in fitness'). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned about swimming in paragraph 3?
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 viết: 'A daily or even weekly swim puts no pain on muscles' (bơi không gây đau cơ), chứ KHÔNG nói bơi giúp làm giảm bớt cơn đau cơ có sẵn ('reduces muscle pain'). Do đó B là phương án KHÔNG được nhắc đến trong đoạn 3.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?

options.text: To urge office workers to do more exercising before they retire
To stress the importance of staying active for a healthy retirement
To suggest a variety of fitness activities for people in retirement

questions.explanationVi: Toàn bài viết nhấn mạnh việc bắt đầu và duy trì vận động thể chất khi lớn tuổi và nghỉ hưu để có một cuộc sống khỏe mạnh kéo dài ('stress the importance of staying active for a healthy retirement'). Phương án B đúng.

tasks.transcript:
[Monologue 1]: Welcome back to our weekly community workshop schedule. Last week we covered urban transport systems, and our ongoing foreign language seminars are running as usual. However, joining our calendar for the very first time this week is an introductory module on modern Art appreciation.

[Monologue 2]: Attention passengers on the coastal line. We have just departed Bedford station. The next immediate station stop will be Glenfield, where passengers for Rockport should remain on board until the final terminal.

[Monologue 3]: Class, originally I asked you to form groups of five, and some of you prepared for teams of four. But since several students are attending the sports meet today, please rearrange yourselves so there are strictly three members in each working group right now.

[Monologue 4]: Good evening visitors. Please note our special holiday operating hours. The exhibition halls normally close at 6 p.m. on weekdays and 7 p.m. on Saturdays. Tonight, however, for our Stargazing Festival, the Science Centre will remain open until 11 p.m.

[Monologue 5]: Customer announcement: We have reorganized our supermarket layout. The bakery department has moved to the middle aisle, and dairy items remain at the back. Fresh fruits and seasonal vegetables are now displayed right at the front entrance as you walk in.

[Monologue 6]: Security announcement: Passengers are reminded never to leave bags unattended anywhere in the concourse. Any unattended luggage will be promptly taken away by security staff and inspected. Please keep personal items with you at all times.

[Monologue 7]: Final call for passengers on flight VN148 to Da Nang. Boarding will conclude in five minutes at Gate 12. Please have your boarding passes and identity cards ready for immediate boarding.

questions.prompt: Which topic is new this week?
questions.explanationVi: Trong audio: 'joining our calendar for the very first time this week is an introductory module on modern Art appreciation'. Chủ đề mới tuần này là Nghệ thuật (Art). Transport là tuần trước, Languages là đang diễn ra như thường lệ. Đáp án A đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to one conversation TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
[Conversation 1]:
Man: That's a nice leather bag, Jennifer! Did it cost a fortune?
Woman: The tag said $100, and the shopkeeper offered it for $90, but because of a small scratch on the strap, I managed to get it for just $80!

[Conversation 2]:
Man: Are you going camping this weekend? The forecast says it might clear up and be sunny.
Woman: I hope so! It was overcast on Monday, and then it's done nothing but pour with rain every single day this whole week.

[Conversation 3]:
Man: So which dress do you prefer? The blue one matches your eyes, and the green is quite elegant.
Woman: Blue is a bit too dark, and green doesn't suit me. I think I'll go for the bright orange one instead.

[Conversation 4]:
Man: What did you think of the historical drama? The soundtrack was fantastic, wasn't it?
Woman: The music was okay, and the ending felt rather predictable. But what I loved most was the stunning period costumes and outfits worn by the cast.

[Conversation 5]:
Man: Excuse me, how do I get to the college main entrance? I'm on Carr Street near King Street.
Woman: You need to walk past King Street and turn right into Dell Street. The main gate is located directly on Dell Street opposite the park.

[Conversation 6]:
Man: How is your new administrative secretary settling in?
Woman: Her desk is always spotlessly tidy and she never loses files, but she just sits there waiting for instructions and shows no initiative whatsoever during office hours.

[Conversation 7]:
Man: Did Jane arrive on schedule yesterday?
Woman: No, although it departed on time without being cancelled, they had to circle the airport for two extra hours due to turbulent crosswinds. The entire flight took much longer than expected.

questions.prompt: What did Jennifer pay for the bag?
questions.explanationVi: Trong audio: 'I managed to get it for just $80!' Giá Jennifer thực tế trả là $80. $100 là giá trên tem, $90 là giá người bán gợi ý ban đầu. Đáp án A đúng.

tasks.title: Part 3: Extended Recordings
tasks.instructions: There are 6 questions in this part. You will listen to two longer recordings TWICE. For questions 15 to 20, decide whether each statement is Correct (True) or Incorrect (False). Choose A for True and B for False.
tasks.transcript:
[Recording 1 - Phone Conversation on Swimming Classes]:
Clerk: Good morning, Greenfield Leisure Centre.
Ashley: Hello. I'm calling to register for your adult swimming programme. I'm basically a complete beginner because I've never had formal lessons and can barely float.
Clerk: In that case, our beginner course focuses on breathing and basic water confidence, whereas our intermediate class requires you to already swim at least 25 metres continuously.
Ashley: That sounds ideal. How long is each practice session?
Clerk: Sessions run for forty-five minutes of instructional time, followed by fifteen minutes of optional free swim, so the scheduled lesson itself is strictly 45 minutes.
Ashley: Perfect. And when does the upcoming summer term commence?
Clerk: The first session for beginners officially kicks off on Monday, July 21st, and runs for six consecutive weeks.

[Recording 2 - Teacher's Classroom Exam Briefing]:
Teacher: Good morning everyone. Please write down these key arrangements for our upcoming final examination. While the faculty originally considered July 22nd, our formal paper has been officially scheduled for Friday, July 25th in Main Hall B.
Student: Excuse me, how long will the exam take?
Teacher: Regarding duration: your mid-term assessment was 45 minutes long. This final exam will last for precisely 60 minutes, giving you an extra 15 minutes to complete the essay section. In terms of revision scope, do not spend time re-reading chapters one through three since those were already tested in the mid-term. Focus your revision entirely on chapters four through eight.

tasks.title: Task 1: Employee of the Year Profile
tasks.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words for your company's website introducing the employee who won 'Best employee of the year'. Use the information in the box.

writingPrompts.title: Best Employee of the Year Announcement
writingPrompts.instructions: Write at least 80 words introducing Nguyen Thuy Ha. Use all the given information.

dataCard.Key Achievements: Led 3 successful projects; Won an office improvement contest

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: We are proud to announce that Ms. Nguyen Thuy Ha has been awarded the prestigious title of 'Best Employee of the Year'. Having served our company as a dedicated Project Manager for over 10 years, Ms. Ha has consistently demonstrated outstanding leadership, professional competence, and remarkable enthusiasm. Throughout the past year, she has successfully led three major commercial projects, delivering exceptional results ahead of schedule. Furthermore, she recently won first prize in our annual office improvement contest with innovative initiatives to boost workplace productivity. We sincerely congratulate Ms. Ha on this well-deserved achievement and thank her for being a wonderful role model for the entire team.

tasks.title: Task 2: Opinion Paragraph (Choice)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two topics below and write a paragraph of at least 100 words. You should state your opinion clearly and provide supporting ideas and examples.

writingPrompts.title: Choose Topic 2.1 or Topic 2.2
writingPrompts.instructions: Choose ONE topic and write at least 100 words.

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about the effects of air pollution on people's lives.
guidelines: Respiratory health issues and chronic illnesses
Impact on outdoor activities and lifestyle

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about the benefits of learning about the history of a country.
guidelines: Understanding cultural roots and national identity
Learning valuable lessons from past events
Fostering patriotism and appreciation for ancestors

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Air pollution has become one of the most critical environmental challenges severely threatening people's daily lives and well-being. Firstly, contaminated air filled with fine particulate matter causes serious respiratory problems, including asthma, chronic bronchitis, and cardiovascular diseases, especially among young children and elderly citizens. Secondly, poor air quality restricts outdoor activities and physical exercise, which lowers individuals' overall fitness and psychological comfort. Finally, the prevalence of pollution-related diseases places a heavy financial burden on families and society due to soaring healthcare expenses and reduced labor productivity. Therefore, both governments and citizens must take immediate measures, such as adopting green transportation and planting more urban trees, to combat air pollution effectively.

tasks.instructions: In this part, you will answer 5 to 6 questions about familiar topics. Speak naturally and elaborate on your answers.

tasks.title: Part 2: Solution Discussion / Description (5 minutes)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two cards below. You will have 1 minute to prepare your notes, 1.5 to 2 minutes to talk, and then answer two follow-up questions.

speakingPrompts.title: Cue Card Choice
speakingPrompts.instructions: Select Card 1 or Card 2 to speak.

cueCards.title: Describe a time you saw a wild animal.
prompts: How you felt when you saw it
furtherQuestions: Do you often see wild animals in your neighborhood? Why (not)?
What can people do to protect wild animals?
cueCards.sampleResponse: A memorable time when I saw a wild animal was during a family trip to Cuc Phuong National Park last summer. While we were walking along a quiet forest trail in the morning, we spotted a rare wild monkey sitting high on a tree branch eating fruit. It looked very active and curious as it watched our group from above. I felt extremely excited and amazed because it was the first time I had ever seen a wild animal in its natural habitat rather than in a zoo. That experience made me realize how important it is to protect forests and wildlife conservation areas.

cueCards.title: Describe an activity that you did to keep fit.
prompts: How you felt after doing it
furtherQuestions: Is it easy to stay fit in modern life? Why (not)?
What can people do to have a healthy lifestyle?
cueCards.sampleResponse: An activity that I regularly do to keep fit is jogging in the park near my house. I started this habit about six months ago, and I usually go jogging four times a week for thirty minutes every early morning before going to school. Breathing the fresh morning air and listening to my favorite music while running helps me wake up my body and burn calories effectively. After each jogging session, I always feel much more energetic, relaxed, and ready to focus on my classes throughout the day.
